description: This file contains shell functions for checking and repairing ext2, ext3, and ext4 filesystems using e2fsck, including logging and error handling functions.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs a filesystem check on the specified device using e2fsck with error handling and logging.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck for ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck for ext3 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper for fsck_e2fsck for ext4 filesystem.
